info.name: Stark Bank Balance Payment Request API

params.name: centerId
params.description: Unique ID of the targeted cost center. You can check out the cost center ID directly on its approval section on our Web Banking. Example: 5656565656565656

params.name: after
params.description: Filter entities created after this date.

params.name: before
params.description: Filter entities created before this date.

params.name: cursor
params.description: String used to get the next batch of results. Our SDKs handle this for you.

params.name: fields
params.description: List of strings to filter response JSON keys. Not available in the SDKs.

params.name: ids
params.description: List of strings to get specific entities by ids.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per cursor. Max = 100.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order considered in the response. Options are: "created", "-created", "updated" and "-updated". "-" means descending order. Default is "-created".

params.name: status
params.description: Filter payment requests by the specified status. Example: success

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter entities that contain the specified tags.

params.name: type
params.description: Filters payment requests by the type inferred from the payment parameter, if it is not a dictionary. Example: boleto-payment

items.docs: Here you can list and filter payment requests created by the requesting user. We return it paged.
Use this route to create new payment requests in our Web Banking approval flow.
